facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports that a 2 June 2026 Dakar workshop of the digital ministry, DIAL and ANSD named the national data exchange platform among Senegal's existing foundations, while institutions still run parallel systems and data-sharing mechanisms need consolidation.

SEN.note: Article does not say the platform is live or how many bodies are connected.
New Deal for Technology strategy is named only as the wider frame of the workshop; no standing, text or period stated.

facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports that a 2 June 2026 Dakar workshop named the National Interoperability Framework among Senegal's existing foundations for digital transformation.

SEN.note: Adoption date, text and any duty to follow it not stated.
